newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht stronger late, interbank rate rises.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht stronger late, interbank rate rises.

text.p: The Thai baht was higher against the dollar late on Thursday as tighter liquidity prompted selling of the U.S. unit for baht, dealers said.
The baht firmed to 25.926/25.931 to the dollar late from 25.927/25.933 in early morning trade, dealers said.
"There were very few activities today. But the tightening liquidity in the money market triggered some selling of the dollar for baht today," said one dealer at a European bank.
The overnight interbank rate was up further to 10.00-10.50 percent late from 9.50-10.00 percent earlier as the money supply continue to tighten, dealers said.
The lower liquidity was attributed to bank borrowings for the next reserve requirement and the upcoming valued tax payment which comes due in the middle of middle of the month, dealers said.
"But the liquidity is likely to ease tomorrow after some dollar selling today," one money market dealer said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was traded at 10.50/11.50 satangs per dollar late, unchanged from early morning trade.
